_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.2.132 uses the standalone firmware runner for built-in GUI presets. The GUI verifies parameters and mode acknowledgements before one START; firmware owns all phases and breaks. Real product completion and fresh vented IDLE are required before marking a simulator row successful. Valinor retains its existing firmware and control profile.

The protected uploader now decodes the actual inflation/CVP flag order and restores supported scalar protocol settings with CRC and readback. Saved calibration and SysID values are preserved. Explicit firmware phase annotations keep inflation and inter-cycle waits out of deflation feedback; simulator direct starts retain verified preset settings in the recording manifest. Valinor retains its GUI label throughout repeated Max runs to prevent standalone presentation from switching system power off after the first trial.

Validation: Default four complete GUI START cycles, Arduino 20,631/20,631 (100%), NI 280,740 samples with no gaps/backtracks; 0-16 ms completion-to-deflation dispatch. Both branch layout audits and smoke tests pass; 126 Default/130 earlier Valinor focused checks plus 75 final CRC/phase checks. Ten-minute Valinor START measurements are retained in the delivery study. Matching runner execution is separate from accurate arterial MAP, pulse preservation, physical knob/button testing and fleet SysID qualification. No new controller tuning is released.

Final Valinor check: seven completed Max runs over 685.187 seconds, Arduino 20,129/20,129 (100%), NI 338,870 samples with zero gaps/backtracks. Valinor v3.2.132 also protects START/STOP with CRC and recognizes the actual DEF_PID deflation state. Final protected Default restoration is followed by the scored ten-minute seed-213 soak. Initial overspeed and Wrist undertracking remain measured limitations.

Session-only annotations no longer hide valid deflation state feedback. This was reproduced on all seven actual gauge runs and fixed on both branches with state/phase regressions. Final ten-minute seed213 post-restore soak completed six runs: Arduino26,345/26,345 (100%), NI312,000 samples, zero gaps/backtracks; OLED live and vented IDLE verified. Firmware unchanged.
